title: SpongeBob Spellforge
description: In a cluttered attic bedroom under a starry skylight, SpongeBob SquarePants stands glowing with yellow magic, pointing upward while holding a staff. To his left, a blue ethereal woman with flowing hair takes a selfie with a smartphone; to his right, a green ethereal woman with dark curly hair plays a golden saxophone, surrounded by floating lotuses, white birds, and magical sparkles.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene in a wooden attic bedroom with a starry skylight, featuring SpongeBob SquarePants glowing with yellow magic energy, pointing upward with one hand while holding a glowing staff in the other, standing between two ethereal women: one with flowing curly hair and glowing blue skin taking a selfie with a smartphone, the other with long dark curly hair and glowing green skin playing a golden saxophone, floating white birds, glowing lotus flowers, magical sparkles and runes filling the air, messy bed and cluttered floor visible, whimsical and mystical atmosphere
